Section 2 - Purpose
(1)
This Policy and associated procedures affirm the commitment La Trobe University has to the health and safety of all members within the University Community in preventing both physical and psychological workplace injuries, disease and ill health through a prevention led, systematic and risk-based approach.
Section 3 - Scope
(2)
This Policy applies to:
all staff and members of the University Community (including Council members, volunteers, students, contractors and associates);
all University campuses and research areas.
Section 4 - Key Decisions
Key decisions
Role
See Health & Safety Procedures
Section 5 - Policy Statement
(3)
La Trobe University confirms its commitment to promoting a healthy and safe environment through:
compliance with all relevant legislation, regulations including model WHS regulations, licensing requirements, applicable industry standards (such as Australian Standards) and recognised codes of practice including compliance codes to ensure lawful and lead-practice operations;
preventative approaches to hazard identification and risk management, ensuring risks are systematically identified, assessed, controlled, and regularly reviewed to minimise harm;
a structured and systematic framework for the management of health and safety, integrating governance, accountability, planning, implementation, and continuous evaluation;
establishment of measurable objectives, targets, and key performance indicators to monitor performance and drive ongoing improvement in health and safety outcomes;
active engagement through meaningful consultation and clear communication with staff, students, and other stakeholders to support informed decision-making and shared responsibility;
encouragement of innovation and continuous improvement, fostering adaptive practices and learning to enhance health and safety performance over time; and
promotion of positive role modelling, capability development, and knowledge building that not only supports the University community but also equips individuals with lifelong health and safety awareness beyond their time at the University.
